splash.intent: Show that the app is starting until the stored session picks the first screen.

authWelcome.intent: Let a signed-out person pick Citizen Voter or Election Auditor in one tap and open that role’s dashboard.

eligibility.intent: Tell a citizen within seconds, even offline, whether their age meets a country’s minimum voting age, and who vouched for the answer.

auditor.intent: Let an election auditor review every country’s minimum voting age exactly as the shared Rust rules apply it.
